normal_instruction_dataflow.fact: Let S=callee entry RSP and N=entry RAX. RSP becomes S-0x10.
R11=0. LEA1a33800 sets R10=S+8; SUB1a33805 subtracts N modulo64.
If unsigned subtraction borrowed, CMOVB sets R10=0; otherwise retains S+8-N modulo64.
R11=QWORD GS:[0x10], called B here. No TLS field business name recovered.
If unsigned R10>=B, branch directly to restore block1a33830.
Otherwise AND R10W,0xf000 preserves upper48 bits and clears low12: target L=R10 & 0xfffffffffffff000.
Loop: R11=(R11-0x1000)mod64; BYTE[R11]=0; CMP R10,R11; JNE repeats until equal.
Restore R10/R11 from the two saved stack qwords, ADD RSP,0x10, RET.
